components.name: commons-compress
components.description: Apache Commons Compress defines an API for working with compression and archive formats. These include bzip2, gzip, pack200, LZMA, XZ, Snappy, traditional Unix Compress, DEFLATE, DEFLATE64, LZ4, Brotli, Zstandard and ar, cpio, jar, tar, zip, dump, 7z, arj.

components.name: commons-codec
components.description: The Apache Commons Codec component contains encoders and decoders for various formats such as Base16, Base32, Base64, digest, and Hexadecimal. In addition to these widely used encoders and decoders, the codec package also maintains a collection of phonetic encoding utilities.

components.name: commons-io
components.description: The Apache Commons IO library contains utility classes, stream implementations, file filters, file comparators, endian transformation classes, and much more.

components.name: cortexj-train-distributed

components.name: cortexj-train-data
components.description: LM fine-tuning datasets: JSONL corpora (raw text, SFT), batching, loss masks, token fingerprints (ADR-021/022). Engine-neutral, pure Java. Core never depends on this module.

components.name: cortexj-train-djl-models
components.description: Generic Llama-family decoder as pure-Java DJL blocks, HF safetensors weight loading, LoRA wiring (ADR-021/022). Depends on the DJL engine only.
